Name: Sprinter (A Heelies Mod Rework)
Author: jevonlipsey
Description:
[b]Update 1.0.1:
[list]
[*][b]Fixed missing animation[/b]
[*][b]Fixed SMAPI console log spam[/b]
[/list]
Sprinter[/b] is a fork of the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7751]HeeliesMod[/url] created by [b]moonbaseboss[/b] (also known as fakemonster). This mod retains the core concept of activating a speed boost with a key press, while improving animation behavior and adding a visual dirt kick-up effect to enhance the sense of motion.
When activated, the mod grants your farmer a temporary speed boost. Unlike the original mod, Sprinter preserves the natural walking and running animations, allowing for a smoother and more immersive experience. A dirt puff effect appears behind the player while rolling, visually conveying momentum and speed.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iIbgyps.gif[/img]

[b]Features[/b][list]
[*]Activate a speed boost with a configurable key (default: Space or RightShoulder)
[*]Preserves natural walking and running animations
[*]Adds a dirt kick-up visual effect behind the player while rolling
[*]Gradual speed decay over time
[*]Configurable speed and stamina cost
[/list][b]Installation[/b][list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.0.0 or higher
[*]Download and extract this mod into your Mods folder
[*]Launch the game
[/list][b]
Configuration
[/b]After launching the game once with the mod installed, a [b]config.json[/b]
file will be generated in the mod's folder. You can edit the following options:

[list]
[*][b]heeliesButton[/b]
[*]T﻿he key used to activate the speed boost. Default is "Space, RightShoulder"
[*]See the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings#Button_codes]Stardew Valley Wiki [/url]﻿for valid button codes.
[/list][list]
[*][b]initialSpeedBoost[/b]
[*]The initial speed value applied when activating the boost. Default is 3.5.
[*]Higher values result in faster movement.
[*][b]staminaCost[/b]
[*]The amount of stamina consumed when activating the boost. Default is 0
[/list][b]
Credits
[/b]Sprinter is based on HeeliesMod by [b]moonbaseboss[/b] (aka fakemonster).
All original credit goes to them for the concept and implementation.
This version was reworked by [b]Jevon Lipsey[/b] to preserve animations and add visual effects.

[b]See Also
[url=https://github.com/jevonlipsey/stardew-valley-sprinter]Source code[/url]
[/b]
